framework: 3-tuple per defense-like variant: (1) crisis_alpha across stress periods; (2) Core MDD pp improvement vs forge_recomputed_M4; (3) bad/normal realized risk ratio by LRI state — replacing IC ratio per Plan MEDIUM 7 (LRO is risk overlay not alpha)

core_baseline.name: forge_recomputed_M4
core_baseline.rationale: M4 baseline re-computed by forge under IDENTICAL measurement basis as 7 LRO strategies — used as PASS gate Core baseline (Plan §1 baseline_decision_basis)

frozen_reference_l274_NOT_used_as_gate.use: frozen historical reference for transparency only (Plan §5 #8). NOT used as PASS/FAIL gate

tuple_1_crisis_alpha.interpretation: GFC drawdown WORSE than M4 baseline (-7.37pp) — cap intervention does not address MKT-driven crisis (TDC_MKT 0.65). Other stress periods nearly identical to S1.

tuple_2_mdd_pp_vs_core.interpretation: MDD WORSE by 8.17pp vs Core baseline. FAIL.

tuple_3_bad_normal_realized_risk_ratio.interpretation: LRI predictive on vol axis (1.71× HighRisk amplification). Max DD paradoxically less severe in HighRisk than Normal — LRO_cap fails to use this LRI signal effectively (no compression).
tuple_3_bad_normal_realized_risk_ratio.axis_verdict: FAIL (LRI predictive but LRO_cap intervention does not act effectively — bad-state vol >0.90 ratio)

LRO_cap.verdict_3_tuple: FAIL — All 3 axes fail or degrade vs Core baseline. cap-only intervention does not improve MDD vs M4.

tuple_1_crisis_alpha.interpretation: Cash overlay during GFC reduces drawdown +7.4pp vs S1 (no overlay) and +0.6pp vs M4. LMR period -16.4pp due to cash drag during recovery (cash 25% in HighRisk persistent state).

tuple_2_mdd_pp_vs_core.interpretation: MDD WORSE by 2.75pp vs Core M4 baseline. cash overlay alone cannot beat M4 outer regime cash schedule which is already optimized.

tuple_3_bad_normal_realized_risk_ratio.interpretation: Cash overlay compresses bad-state vol from 1.71× (LRO_cap) to 1.46× — best of single-overlay variants. Max DD compression best for HighRisk (-0.091 vs -0.160 Normal).
tuple_3_bad_normal_realized_risk_ratio.axis_verdict: PARTIAL (HighRisk vol >0.90 but compressed substantially; max DD compression real)

LRO_cash.verdict_3_tuple: PARTIAL — GFC crisis_alpha real (+7.4pp vs S1). MDD slightly WORSE than M4 (-2.75pp). Compresses bad-state vol but not below 0.90 threshold.

tuple_1_crisis_alpha.interpretation: Stress periods virtually identical to M4 baseline. Cap intervention does not contribute additional defense when M4 cash already active.

tuple_2_mdd_pp_vs_core.interpretation: MDD virtually identical to M4 (-0.08pp). Cap intervention adds NO measurable improvement.

tuple_3_bad_normal_realized_risk_ratio.interpretation: Virtually identical to M4 alone. cap layer adds no compression because M4 cash already active in similar months.

M4+LRO_cap.verdict_3_tuple: MARGINAL — virtually identical to M4 alone (MDD diff -0.08pp, Sharpe diff -0.022). LRO cap tightening adds NO meaningful improvement.

tuple_1_crisis_alpha.interpretation: GFC nearly equal M4. Inflation +0.8pp better than M4. LMR -15pp due to cash drag (LRI HighRisk persistent forces 25% cash through recovery).

tuple_2_mdd_pp_vs_core.interpretation: MDD IMPROVEMENT +0.42pp vs Core M4 baseline — only positive variant of the 4. Below Plan §12 CONDITIONAL_PASS 1pp threshold.

tuple_3_bad_normal_realized_risk_ratio.interpretation: Best of 4: bad-state vol compressed to 1.48× (4-tuple best). Max DD compression equal to M4+LRO_cap.
tuple_3_bad_normal_realized_risk_ratio.axis_verdict: PARTIAL (HighRisk vol >0.90 but best compression of 4 variants)

M4+LRO_cash.verdict_3_tuple: BEST OF FOUR — only variant with positive MDD pp improvement vs M4 (+0.42pp) AND best bad/normal vol ratio compression (1.48×). But CAGR cost -1.52pp, MDD improvement below 1pp threshold.

summary.best_variant_summary: Only variant with positive MDD improvement (+0.42pp) and best bad-state vol compression (1.48×). But improvement magnitude below Plan §12 CONDITIONAL_PASS 1pp threshold, and cash drag costs CAGR -1.52pp.
summary.axiom_verdict: AX-001 v2 NOT SATISFIED for any LRO variant as deployment-grade defense intervention. LRI state has documented predictive power (1.46-1.71× vol amplification) — supports MONITORING role only. Recommend KEEP STR_1715 100% PG2 with M4 schedule unchanged.
